item.title: Hardening Firefox with Claude Mythos Preview
item.description:
📝 2022733 Triggers a parent UAF by flooding WebTransport with thousands of certificate hashes to stretch a race condition in a refcount-heavy copy loop, and exploits that race condition over IPC from a compromised content process. Note that a number of these bugs are sandbox escapes, which would need to be combined with other exploits to achieve a full-chain Firefox compromise. These reports presume that the sandboxed process that renders site content has already been compromised with some separate bug, and is now running attacker-controlled machine.
🔗 Read more: https://hacks.mozilla.org/2026/05/behind-the-scenes-hardening-firefox/
